description: Set within a quiet residential neighborhood, this single-story home offers a straightforward layout with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms across approximately 1,515 square feet. The home reflects its original character and age, with a functional floor plan that provides a solid starting point for updates and improvements over time. Natural light moves through the main living areas, and a sunroom extends the footprint, adding a flexible space that can be reimagined for relaxation, hobbies, or additional everyday use. Outdoors, the 6,899 square foot lot provides a generous backyard setting with room to create, expand, or simply enjoy as-is, whether envisioned as a garden, entertaining space, or long-term transformation. An attached two-car garage adds convenience, while central HVAC supports year-round comfort. With a usable existing structure and a spacious lot, the property presents a clear opportunity for those looking to improve and add value over time.
